title.zh: Mashinsky Accepts Lifetime Industry Ban and Up to $35 Million in Conditional Payments
title.en: Mashinsky Accepts Lifetime Industry Ban and Up to $35 Million in Conditional Payments

current_state.zh: Alex Mashinsky agreed to a lifetime crypto industry ban and up to $35 million in conditional payments under a New York settlement layered on top of his federal forfeiture obligations and existing FTC and CFTC penalties.
current_state.en: Alex Mashinsky agreed to a lifetime crypto industry ban and up to $35 million in conditional payments under a New York settlement layered on top of his federal forfeiture obligations and existing FTC and CFTC penalties.
